Self.Wiki: Environment map effect box (vanilla: Env_BoxNNN). It applies the env map of the Env_PointNNN point with its env map number, and links to irradiance volume GIIV NNN.

DisplayDistance.Wiki: The distance from camera required before enabling envmap. 0 = always enabled.

FadeDistance.Wiki: The distance it takes for an envmap to fully transition into view.

ApplyParallaxCorrection.Wiki: Applies parallax correction to the env map (non-zero = on).

LegacyPriority.Wiki: The box priority used only by old MSB versions (before 0x38). 10 in every retail box; use Priority instead.

EnvMapNumber.Wiki: The env map number this box uses (Env_Point and GIIV volume). -1: the three digits at the end of the box name (Env_Box015 = 15).

BoundsExpandNegative.Wiki: Extends the influence bounds of the box beyond its shape on the negative X/Y/Z sides, in metres. 0 in retail.

BoundsExpandPositive.Wiki: Extends the influence bounds of the box beyond its shape on the positive X/Y/Z sides, in metres. 0 in retail.

UnkT2C.Wiki: Selects two irradiance volume flags (Elden Ring): 0 = both on, 1 = only the second, 2 = only the first.

IsModifyLight.Wiki: Affects lighting with other fields when set. 1 in every retail box.

AdditionalEnvMapNumber.Wiki: A second env map / irradiance volume number for this box. When 0 or more, the volume setup runs a second time with it. -1: none.

Priority.Wiki: The box priority. Retail uses 10, 30, 20, 31, 32, 35 and others.
